prompt:
Edit only the first reference image, the square FUJIFILM CLASSIC Neg. film-simulation cover. The second image is the APPROVED app collection, for overall visual weight only. Produce ONE refined standalone square cover, NOT a grid or mockup. This is a very restrained refinement of the first image, not a new design.

Keep this exact recognizable graphic identity and hierarchy: FUJIFILM ivory wordmark with its red accent at the upper left; vivid Fuji green paper background; yellow ultra-condensed CLASSIC on one line with Neg. beneath toward the right; the solid royal-blue diagonal wedge in the lower-left corner; small ivory FILM SIMULATION at the lower right. Preserve the existing lettering forms, condensed type character, colors by role, straight geometry, placement of brand/footer, and very fine paper texture.

Make exactly these visual refinements:
1. Reduce the neon brightness of the green background moderately. Move it toward a rich fresh leaf/Fuji green around #149A3C, retaining clear green character and saturation. It should be visibly calmer alongside the nine approved covers but still fresh and identifiable. Avoid olive, dull brown, teal, black-green, or washed out green.
2. Reduce the overall CLASSIC / Neg. title block by approximately 10 to 12 percent in size, keeping the same condensed letterforms, two-line arrangement, and the right-aligned Neg. relationship. Give CLASSIC comfortable left and right margins. Keep it prominent and fully legible as a small thumbnail. Preserve the yellow, with a subtly warmer printed yellow, and the existing dark-green offset print shadow, making that shadow slightly less heavy only if needed. Do not add new type or new lines.

Retain the lower-left blue diagonal wedge's original position, size and shape. Retain the brand and tiny footer without introducing any other content. The result should feel like the same authentic official-mode-inspired printed cover, gently tuned so it does not dominate the whole collection.

Square, full bleed, flat front artwork, crisp print, uniform very fine paper grain. No photo, 3D box, mockup, frame, rounded-corner canvas, drop shadow outside the print, ribbon, badge, gradient decoration, or extra symbols. No JustShoot, RAW, sRGB, arrows, workflow labels or slogans. Keep only FUJIFILM, CLASSIC, Neg., FILM SIMULATION as in the target. Output one 1024 by 1024 square cover.
